definitions.full: H5084. nadan II. [ נָדָן ] noun [masculine] sheath (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic נִדְנָא ( ᵑ7 Talmud); Persian loan-word Nö GGA, 1884, 1022 ); — אֶלנְֿדָנָהּ׃ חַדְבּוֺ וַיָּשֶׁב 1Chr 21:27 .
